parent_objective: Portable, deterministic, machine-readable object-interaction discovery: every semantically observed player/host object menu, selection and outcome accumulates class-based action knowledge usable for safe queue recommendations across saves.
route: Moonwake fifth gear, current P95 -> P82 -> P08 -> P07 -> P124; catalog + resolver and AGENTS.md read; local P08 game host unavailable from provider connector.
selected_design: Add a narrowly owned opt-in object-action catalog fed by validated semantic observation events, persisted as a bounded atomic local projection by existing listener. Query ranks only independently reviewed helpful effects for current fresh menu; never dispatches game input.

alternatives.name: Global OS click/key capture
alternatives.reason: violates human-first/peripheral sovereignty and conflates UI clicks with object semantics

alternatives.name: Hardcoded list of Sims object IDs and interactions
alternatives.reason: not portable across saves, packs, patches or object variants

alternatives.name: Extend existing hover schema to include all menu semantics
alternatives.reason: would break existing validated event shape and mix tooltip with menu observation

alternatives.name: Separate bounded semantic object-event port adjoining host_listener
alternatives.reason: reuses session lifecycle and keeps captured facts separate from learned usefulness

invariants: Never scan input outside explicit BetterInstincts observer session
No arbitrary or raw UI text in portable catalog
Patch-qualified menu knowledge is not live action proof
Do not alter BI-002 gate or unrelated PR-owned paths
forbidden: Live game execution without verified local host
acceptance: Deterministic class-keyed discovery without household identity as global key
Menu -> selection -> reviewed outcome must bind to matching session and replay identifier
Current menu query must match exact session/capture/object/patch and available action
Three verified helpful nonharmful examples before useful action recommendation
Bounded atomic opt-in persistence in existing dist host-listener
CI and readback receipts, no invented local live certification
